dct_description_sm: Please note that the covidHR files are what you need if you just want the consolidated shapefile. The other files are for those who want to rebuild the shapefile. covid.R builds the shapefile from the federal data as well as the Saskatchewan, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia files.
